gopca64.method: the propagated GO multi-hot (registry embedding `go`, SGD annotations propagated over is_a and part_of, terms with >= 10 genes), projected on its first 64 principal components (fitted over the 1,121 genes, explained variance 0.795) and split into positive and negative parts as affine columns over the 1,121 labeled genes; written by go_affine_store.py

source_store_provenance.method: pFBA (parsimonious_reference_flux, two scipy HiGHS LPs) with the gene deleted through cobra.manipulation.knock_out_model_genes
